scenario.zh: 为执法或军事任务设计基因优化和装备配置方案
scenario.en: Design genetic optimization and equipment configuration for law enforcement or military missions

instruction.zh: 选择工作犬的主要任务场景
instruction.en: Select the primary mission scenario for the working dog

output.zh: 需要增强嗅觉和长时专注力
output.en: Requires enhanced olfaction and sustained focus

input.zh: 在机场、边境口岸和军事基地检测隐藏爆炸物,工作时长6-8小时,需在复杂气味环境中保持高灵敏度
input.en: Detect concealed explosives at airports, border crossings and military bases during 6-8 hour shifts while maintaining high sensitivity in complex odor environments

output.zh: 嗅觉受体基因增强提升痕量化学物检测能力,线粒体优化延长工作耐力,减少遗传性鼻腔疾病风险
output.en: Enhanced olfactory receptor genes for trace chemical detection, mitochondrial optimization for extended endurance, reduced genetic risk of nasal conditions

output.zh: 需要增强体能和环境适应性
output.en: Requires enhanced stamina and environmental adaptation

input.zh: 在地震废墟、山区或灾害现场搜寻幸存者,需穿越不稳定地形并在极端温度下工作
input.en: Locate survivors in earthquake rubble, mountainous terrain or disaster sites while traversing unstable ground and operating in extreme temperatures

output.zh: 肌肉生长基因调节增加力量和耐力,温度调节基因改良提升热适应性,骨骼密度优化防止运动损伤
output.en: Muscle growth gene modulation for increased strength and stamina, temperature regulation gene improvements for thermal adaptation, bone density optimization to prevent injury

instruction.zh: 选择 Anduril 提供的硬件组合

input.zh: 防护背心集成 GPS 和心率传感器
input.en: Protective vest with integrated GPS and heart rate sensors

output.zh: 指挥员接收犬只位置坐标和疲劳预警信号
output.en: Handler receives dog position coordinates and fatigue alerts

detail.zh: 精确到 3 米范围内的位置数据
心率、体温和呼吸频率监测
detail.en: Heart rate, temperature and respiration monitoring

output.zh: 视觉数据共享和环境映射
output.en: Visual data sharing and environmental mapping

input.zh: 护目镜带摄像头,背心含传感器阵列和通信模块
input.en: Goggles with camera, vest with sensor array and communications module

output.zh: 指挥员获得犬只视角实时视频和周围威胁标记
output.en: Handler receives real-time video from dog's perspective and threat markers

detail.zh: 第一人称视角的战场画面传输
化学物质和热源探测数据
detail.en: Chemical agent and heat source detection data

detail.zh: 与小队无线网络的双向数据同步
detail.en: Two-way data sync with squad mesh network

output.zh: 基因目标和装备规格的结构化说明
output.en: Structured specification of genetic targets and equipment specs

input.zh: 已选择的任务类型、基因优化目标和 Anduril 硬件配置
input.en: Selected mission type, genetic optimization targets and Anduril hardware configuration

output.zh: 此方案需提交给 Warhound 进行可行性评估和培育时间表规划,基因编辑需在繁育阶段实施,装备需根据成犬体型定制
output.en: This plan requires submission to Warhound for feasibility assessment and breeding timeline planning; genetic editing must be implemented during breeding phase, equipment must be custom-fitted to adult dog dimensions

takeaway.zh: 演示了任务驱动的基因优化和智能装备选型,实际性能和伦理合规需由 Warhound 团队验证,访问官网提交正式需求
takeaway.en: Illustrated mission-driven genetic optimization and smart equipment selection; actual performance and ethical compliance require verification by Warhound team; visit official site to submit formal requirements
